voiceChatMode.title: Voice chat mode
voiceChatMode.description: Choose proximity or server-wide voice chat.

enableVoiceChat.title: Enable voice chat
enableVoiceChat.description: Allow players to use voice chat.

enableTextChat.title: Enable text chat
enableTextChat.description: Allow players to use text chat.

gameSettingsPreset.title: Difficulty preset
gameSettingsPreset.description: Select Custom to apply the individual gameplay settings below.

gameSettings.playerHealthFactor.title: Player health multiplier
gameSettings.playerHealthFactor.description: Maximum player health. Range: 0.25–4. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.playerManaFactor.title: Player mana multiplier
gameSettings.playerManaFactor.description: Maximum player mana. Range: 0.25–4. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.playerStaminaFactor.title: Player stamina multiplier
gameSettings.playerStaminaFactor.description: Maximum player stamina. Range: 0.25–4. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.playerBodyHeatFactor.title: Body heat multiplier
gameSettings.playerBodyHeatFactor.description: Time players can stay in cold areas before hypothermia. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.playerDivingTimeFactor.title: Diving time multiplier
gameSettings.playerDivingTimeFactor.description: Available oxygen for diving. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.foodBuffDurationFactor.title: Food buff duration multiplier
gameSettings.foodBuffDurationFactor.description: Duration of food buffs. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.shroudTimeFactor.title: Shroud time multiplier
gameSettings.shroudTimeFactor.description: Time players can remain in the Shroud. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.miningDamageFactor.title: Mining effectiveness multiplier
gameSettings.miningDamageFactor.description: Mining damage and resources gathered per hit. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.plantGrowthSpeedFactor.title: Plant growth speed multiplier
gameSettings.plantGrowthSpeedFactor.description: Speed at which plants grow. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.resourceDropStackAmountFact.title: Resource yield multiplier
gameSettings.resourceDropStackAmountFact.description: Materials in loot stacks. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.factoryProductionSpeedFacto.title: Workstation production multiplier
gameSettings.factoryProductionSpeedFacto.description: Production speed at workstations. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.perkUpgradeRecyclingFactor.title: Weapon recycling yield multiplier
gameSettings.perkUpgradeRecyclingFactor.description: Runes recovered from salvaging upgraded weapons. Range: 0–1. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.perkCostFactor.title: Weapon upgrade cost multiplier
gameSettings.perkCostFactor.description: Runes required to upgrade weapons. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.experienceCombatFactor.title: Combat experience multiplier
gameSettings.experienceCombatFactor.description: Experience earned through combat. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.experienceMiningFactor.title: Mining experience multiplier
gameSettings.experienceMiningFactor.description: Experience earned by mining. Range: 0–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.experienceExplorationQuests.title: Exploration and quest experience multiplier
gameSettings.experienceExplorationQuests.description: Experience earned from exploration and quests. Range: 0.25–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enemyDamageFactor.title: Enemy damage multiplier
gameSettings.enemyDamageFactor.description: Enemy damage, excluding bosses. Range: 0.25–5. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enemyHealthFactor.title: Enemy health multiplier
gameSettings.enemyHealthFactor.description: Enemy health, excluding bosses. Range: 0.25–4. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enemyStaminaFactor.title: Enemy stamina multiplier
gameSettings.enemyStaminaFactor.description: Higher values make enemies harder to stun; excludes bosses. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enemyPerceptionRangeFactor.title: Enemy perception multiplier
gameSettings.enemyPerceptionRangeFactor.description: Enemy sight and hearing range; excludes bosses. Range: 0.5–2. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.bossDamageFactor.title: Boss damage multiplier
gameSettings.bossDamageFactor.description: Damage from boss attacks. Range: 0.2–5. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.bossHealthFactor.title: Boss health multiplier
gameSettings.bossHealthFactor.description: Boss health. Range: 0.2–5. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.threatBonus.title: Enemy attack frequency multiplier
gameSettings.threatBonus.description: Enemy attack frequency, excluding bosses. Range: 0.25–4. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enableDurability.title: Weapon durability
gameSettings.enableDurability.description: Weapons can break. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enableStarvingDebuff.title: Hunger and starvation
gameSettings.enableStarvingDebuff.description: Starving players lose health until they eat or drink. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.enableGliderTurbulences.title: Glider turbulence
gameSettings.enableGliderTurbulences.description: Air turbulence affects gliders. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.pacifyAllEnemies.title: Pacify enemies
gameSettings.pacifyAllEnemies.description: Enemies attack only after being attacked; excludes bosses. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.tombstoneMode.title: Death inventory loss
gameSettings.tombstoneMode.description: Choose which backpack items are dropped on death. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.weatherFrequency.title: Weather frequency
gameSettings.weatherFrequency.description: Frequency of weather events. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.fishingDifficulty.title: Fishing difficulty
gameSettings.fishingDifficulty.description: Strength of fish during the fishing minigame. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.randomSpawnerAmount.title: Enemy amount
gameSettings.randomSpawnerAmount.description: Number of enemies in the world. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.aggroPoolAmount.title: Simultaneous enemy attacks
gameSettings.aggroPoolAmount.description: Number of enemies allowed to attack at once. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.tamingStartleRepercussion.title: Taming failure penalty
gameSettings.tamingStartleRepercussion.description: Progress lost when an animal is startled during taming. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.curseModifier.title: Shroud curse difficulty
gameSettings.curseModifier.description: Chance to receive the Shroud curse from relevant enemy attacks. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.fromHungerToStarving.title: Time until starvation (nanoseconds)
gameSettings.fromHungerToStarving.description: Range: 5–20 minutes. One minute = 60,000,000,000 nanoseconds. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.dayTimeDuration.title: Day duration (nanoseconds)
gameSettings.dayTimeDuration.description: Range: 2–60 minutes. One minute = 60,000,000,000 nanoseconds. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.nightTimeDuration.title: Night duration (nanoseconds)
gameSettings.nightTimeDuration.description: Range: 2–60 minutes. One minute = 60,000,000,000 nanoseconds. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

gameSettings.flameLevelFogRemoval.title: Flame level for building in the Shroud
gameSettings.flameLevelFogRemoval.description: Required Flame level to place Flame Altars in the Shroud. Requires the Custom difficulty preset.

userGroups.0.name.title: Group name
userGroups.0.name.description: Name of the first existing player group.

userGroups.0.password.title: Group password
userGroups.0.password.description: Password granting access to this player group. A blank password allows unrestricted entry with these permissions.

userGroups.0.canKickBan.title: Allow kicking and banning
userGroups.0.canKickBan.description: Allow this group to kick or ban players.

userGroups.0.canAccessInventories.title: Allow access to base inventories
userGroups.0.canAccessInventories.description: Allow access to containers in player bases.

userGroups.0.canEditWorld.title: Allow world editing
userGroups.0.canEditWorld.description: Allow terraforming and destruction outside player bases.

userGroups.0.canEditBase.title: Allow base editing
userGroups.0.canEditBase.description: Allow building, terraforming, and adding or removing water in bases.

userGroups.0.canExtendBase.title: Allow Flame Altar changes
userGroups.0.canExtendBase.description: Allow adding, removing, and upgrading Flame Altars.
